生成查询代码
SELECT 
    t.TRADING_DAY AS `日期`,
    t.FUND_NAME AS `基金名称`,
    t.FUND_SYMBOL AS `基金代码`,
    ROUND(t.NET_VALUE/100000000, 2) AS `基金规模(亿)`
FROM
    ETF_SHARES_CHANGE_ROLL t
WHERE
    t.FUND_SYMBOL = '510050.SH'
    AND t.TRADING_DAY = '2026-09-02'
    AND t.HISVALID = 1
    AND t.NET_VALUE IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    t.TRADING_DAY DESC
LIMIT 1
